mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SCREEN_WINDOW (window_id, screen_id, device_id, channel_name, x, y, width, height, source_type, source_url, sync_status, degraded) VALUES (#{windowId}, #{screenId}, #{deviceId}, #{channelName}, #{x}, #{y}, #{width}, #{height}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceUrl}, #{syncStatus}, #{degraded})
mapper.select: SELECT sw.window_id, sw.screen_id, sw.device_id, sw.channel_name, sw.x, sw.y, sw.width, sw.height, sw.source_type, sw.source_url, sw.sync_status, sw.degraded, sw.create_time, sw.update_time, d.device_name, d.device_category, d.support_move, d.support_resize, d.support_overlay, d.max_resolution, d.max_windows FROM SCREEN_WINDOW sw LEFT JOIN DEVICE d ON sw.device_id = d.id WHERE sw.screen_id = #{screenId} ORDER BY sw.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE SCREEN_WINDOW SET x = #{x}, y = #{y}, width = #{width}, height = #{height}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE window_id = #{windowId}
UPDATE SCREEN_WINDOW SET sync_status = #{syncStatus}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE window_id = #{windowId}
UPDATE SCREEN_WINDOW SET sync_status = #{syncStatus}, degraded = #{degraded}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE window_id = #{windowId}
UPDATE SCREEN_WINDOW SET sync_status = #{syncStatus}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND sync_status = 'synced'
UPDATE SCREEN_WINDOW SET sync_status = #{syncStatus}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE screen_id = #{screenId} AND sync_status = 'synced'
UPDATE SCREEN_WINDOW SET sync_status = #{syncStatus}, degraded = #{degraded}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND sync_status = 'synced'
UPDATE SCREEN_WINDOW SET sync_status = #{syncStatus}, degraded = #{degraded}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE screen_id = #{screenId} AND sync_status = 'synced'
